summary: This resolution expresses support for designating September 2025 as "National Kinship Care Month" and encourages Congress to enact policies that support kinship families and improve outcomes for vulnerable children through existing programs like the Social Security Act.

scores.thoughts: This resolution expresses support for Kinship Care Month and encourages policies to support kinship families, including through parts B and E of title IV of the Social Security Act. This directly relates to welfare programs designed to support vulnerable children and families, indicating a desire to expand or improve these services.
